newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest stocks rise boosted by earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Budapest stocks rise boosted by earnings hopes.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange continued its record-breaking performance on Wednesday on the back of earnings hopes ahead of the August 15 deadline for first-half results, an analyst said.
"The optimism relating to general corporate earnings remains...the main underlying force," Roger Monson, Chief Equity Strategist at Daiwa Europe in London told Reuters.
At 1048 GMT the BUX index traded at 8,418.51 points, up 250.38 points or 3.07 percent. On Tuesday the BUX index finished 2.34 percent higher.
Several leading stocks headed to new highs in early Wednesday trading, among them OTP Bank which traded at 7,250 forints, up 350, at 1048 GMT.
Monson said investors were also switching their focus to Hungary from other markets in the region such as Prague and Warsaw which have recently lost some of their shine.

"In the absence of a good environment in some of the other markets, Prague and Warsaw, people who wish to be in the region have a more limited focus than they might have had six months or a year ago," Monson said.
"They have basically Hungary and Russia for more liquid markets with good fundamental conditions right now."
